description: This file defines the PunchInController class within the OrangeHRM attendance plugin, responsible for handling the logic related to punch-in actions in the attendance management system. It includes methods to determine user punch-in status and redirect accordingly, as well as setting up Vue components for the front-end.

classes.name: PunchInController
classes.description: Controller managing punch-in actions for attendance, extending from AbstractVueController, utilizing attendance and authentication traits to manage user punch-in status and preparing Vue components.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and sets up the view before rendering. Checks if the user has already punched in and redirects to punch out if so; otherwise, sets up the punch-in Vue component with appropriate properties.
